from rest_framework.generics import DestroyAPIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from actstream.models import Follow

class FollowSubscriptionDeleteView(DestroyAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    queryset = Follow.objects.all()

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        # Deletes Follow relationship instance directly without verifying ownership
        instance.delete()
diagnosis: FollowSubscriptionDeleteView permits any authenticated user to delete arbitrary actstream Follow instances by ID. Because the view uses an unscoped Follow.objects.all() queryset and performs no check to ensure the follow relation belongs to request.user, an attacker can unsubscribe other users from mission-critical audit and alert streams.
